outcome: risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) after cesarean delivery (CD)
cohort: 701 women with PPH after CD and 2797 women with CD without PPH from seven affiliated medical institutions of Chongqing Medical University between January 1st, 2015 and January 1st, 2020.
finding: The study identified 10 risk factors for PPH after CD and developed a risk-factor model with good predictive performance.
